using System.Data.SqlClient;
using Api.Models;

namespace Api.Repositories;

public class UserRepository
{
    private readonly string _connStr;

    public UserRepository(string connStr)
    {
        _connStr = connStr;
    }

    public async Task<int> DeactivateUserAsync(int userId)
    {
        using var conn = new SqlConnection(_connStr);
        await conn.OpenAsync();
        var cmd = new SqlCommand(
            "UPDATE users SET active = @active WHERE id = @id", conn);
        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@active", false);
        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", userId);
        return await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
    }
}

using Api.Repositories;

namespace Api.Services;

public class UserService
{
    private readonly UserRepository _repo;

    public UserService(UserRepository repo)
    {
        _repo = repo;
    }

    public async Task DeactivateAsync(int userId)
    {
        var affected = await _repo.DeactivateUserAsync(userId);
        if (affected == 0) throw new KeyNotFoundException($"User {userId} not found");
    }
}
